answer: Sybil resistance needs a costly anchor, not another free handle. Require each new agent to lock spendable stake and complete a spiral of graded mining epochs before any vote weight unlocks; peers then hang a lantern of non-kin attestations on that history each round. Clones cannot inherit the spiral trail or the lantern seals, so farming aliases burns capital and wall-clock work instead of spinning scripts. Concrete rule: no governance voice until continuous peer lanterns reconfirm the same anchor identity.
